statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead and privacy contact in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks and discrimination risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with an outside review at least every second year
Annual policy review
Risk check before a new tool, vendor, or AI setting; P10 for AI
Legal and contract duties tracked in the P03 workbook
Written, time-limited exceptions
Restricted data only to vendors bound to protect it, not train on it, and report breaches
Vendor list with data, criticality, contact, and breach terms
Pre-signup vendor check; annual SOC 2 review of the partner and ATS vendor
Exit steps; monthly ATS export
Owner-started, watched remote support; no unattended access
Never relay contractor bank changes; treat requests as suspected fraud
Unique accounts; no shared credentials
Strongest available MFA; no SMS codes where better is offered
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager; change default passwords
Quarterly account review; close unused accounts
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 30 seconds)
Sealed emergency access envelope held by the owner's attorney
Sign-in alerts and monthly review of email and ATS logs
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in the partner portal and the sealed envelope; never on the phone or in email
SSNs and dates of birth never by email or text
Collect only what each step needs
Full-disk encryption on every device
Retention schedule
Shredding, device disposal, and disposal records for consumer information
Five-year retention of security documentation
Automatic updates, antivirus, and official software sources
Separate work network or phone hotspot
AI tools only after P10; scores never reject alone; notice and accommodation; refuse discriminatory client requests; no personal data in consumer chatbots
Annual security course and monthly alerts
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Count people and data elements against 501.171(1)(g); record the determination date
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
No extortion payment without counsel and an OFAC check
Weekly continuity sheet
Partner coverage arrangement if the owner is unavailable
